test_df_show_default: test the DataFrame.show() method displays the default table output with shape and first 5 rows
test_df_show_positive_limit: test the DataFrame.show() method with a positive limit argument to display a subset of rows
test_df_show_negative_limit: test the DataFrame.show() method with a negative limit to show rows from the start based on total minus absolute value
test_df_show_ascii_tables: test the DataFrame.show() method with ascii_tables=True to render tables using ASCII box-drawing characters
test_df_show_float_precision: test the DataFrame.show() method with float_precision to control decimal digit display for floating-point columns
